description: The plan view of inspect data renders the plan of the schema the data bound under even when the read itself fails: the read reports KDLITH-CTX006 on stderr, the full plan of processing/bind/policies.kdl still prints, and the read's exit 1 governs; data.kdl is a byte copy of processing/bind/slot-reject-keeps-held/data.kdl so the stderr golden pins a scenario-relative location
